079DFE  func  write_shadow_sprite
comment write_shadow_sprite Writes the object's shadow as a sprite at Y: the shadow_sprites entry its field shadow_player names, on the floor under it.

# ======== the attract (game/attract) ========
# game state 1 (E42B's second): 079E39 "LDA #$01; STA <$11", 079E41 "LDA <$3B" (each slot its credits: 4817, 481F,
# 4827, 482F) or 079E46 "LDD <$37" (shared): none, the attract's scene by <$01 (a coin this frame, <$51, jumps to scene
# 5); some, game state 2 with its variables cleared (079E89-079ECB)
079E39  func  attract
comment attract The game's state 1, at each frame: with no credits runs the attract's scene (a coin skips to its scene 5), with credits starts the game (state 2).
# scene 0 (E44F's first): by <$02, 079EE3, 079EF6, 079F08, 079F17
079EDA  func  attract_opening_scene
comment attract_opening_scene The attract's scene 0 by its step: the screens cleared, then bank 20's opening run step by step, then the next scene.
# 079EE3 "LDD #$0000; LBSR $97B7" (job 0: all the layers), 079EE9 "LDD #$FFF0; STD <$BE; STD <$CE", "INC <$02"
079EE3  func  attract_clear_screen
comment attract_clear_screen Queues the clearing of the three layers and scrolls both layers to FFF0.
# 079EF6 "LDA <$5D; BNE", 079EFB "LDA #$00; CLRB; STD <$75; LBSR $C931"
079EF6  func  attract_wait_clear
comment attract_wait_clear Waits until the screen is cleared, then sets the tile banks for the map's scene 0, area 0.
# 079F08 "LDB #$20; STB <$0E; SETLN <$0E", "LBRA $6000" (bank 20's attract by the step 4803)
079F08  func  attract_opening_run
comment attract_opening_run Runs bank 20's opening for its step.
# 079F17 "CLRD; STD <$BE; STD <$CE", "LDD #$0000; LBSR $97D3", "INC <$01", 4802-4806 cleared
079F17  func  attract_next_scene
comment attract_next_scene Puts the layers back at 0, silences the sound and goes on to the attract's next scene.
# scene 2: by <$02, 079F3F, 079F52, then fixed_3D's 07A007 (the copyright erased, Binky's and Bongo's texts) and 07A024
079F36  func  attract_title
comment attract_title The attract's scene 2 by its step: the title screen with the copyright, then the Life in Hell characters' credits.
# 079F3F "LDD #$0000; LBSR $97D3", "LBSR $955F", "LDD #$0000; LBSR $97B7"
079F3F  func  attract_title_clear
comment attract_title_clear Silences the sound, clears the objects and queues the clearing of the layers.
# 079F52 "LDA <$5D; LBNE"
079F52  func  attract_title_wait
comment attract_title_wait Waits until the screen is cleared, then draws the title.
# 079F58 scrolls (10, 0), palette requests 7A53 and 0F07, 079F7A-079F80 the map's scene and area 0, 079F94/079F9B
# "LDB #$26; LBSR $C4A3" (26 strips of each layer), 079FB9-079FCD object 4F80 shown: kind 0E, animation 1F, at D0 128; game
# texts 0 (the logo's tiles), 5 (MATT GROENING), 2 (the copyright), 3 and 4, then the palette request 1640 (a fade in)
079F58  func  attract_title_draw
comment attract_title_draw Draws the title screen: both layers' picture, the title object (kind 0E), the logo's tiles, MATT GROENING and the copyright, and fades the colours in.

# ======== the enemies' shared reactions (enemies/reactions) ========
# the step of actions 7 and 8 (loaded_table_07F268/07F26E's third): 07E010 "LDD #$19,X; SUBD #$0020; STD #$19,X;
# LBSR $8662", landed: 07E01E "CLRW #$0F,X" ..., 07DE7C (lying, then up; or dying with no vitality)
07E010  func  enemy_spin_land
comment enemy_spin_land Lets the spinning enemy fall; once it lands it stops and lies down (it gets up, or dies with no vitality left).
# action 8 (07F586 by field action / 0785FC's F662): 07E028 "LDU #$F26E" steps 07E031, 07DFE7, 07E010
07E028  func  enemy_spin_backward
comment enemy_spin_backward Action 8: the enemy hit from the front by an attack of kind 13 spins away backwards, by its step.
# 07E031 "LDA #$20; STA #$3B,X", 07E036 "LDD #$6300; LBSR $8680" (the hit's sound), "LDA #$97; STA #$05,X", "LDD
# #$FE00; STD #$0F,X" (backwards, turned when it faces left), 07E054 "LDD #$0F,X; STD #$3E,X"
07E031  func  enemy_spin_backward_start
comment enemy_spin_backward_start Starts the backward spin: the hit's sound, the spin animation (97), x speed 2 backwards (kept to start it again after a wall) and a time of 20 frames.
# action 0A: 07E05E "LDU #$F274" steps 07E064, 07E0AC, 07E0EC
07E05E  func  enemy_defeated_forward
comment enemy_defeated_forward Action 0A: the enemy defeated from behind is knocked forwards and away, by its step.
# 07E064 "LDA #$8E; STA #$05,X", "LDD #$0080; STD #$0F,X", into 07E06F
07E064  func  enemy_defeated_forward_start
comment enemy_defeated_forward_start Starts the forward knock: animation 8E and x speed 0080 forwards.
# 07E06F "LDA #$88; STA #$00,X", sound 6300, 07E07A "LDD #$0200; STD #$19,X", y speed 0100, time 68 (48 and the y
# speed the other way when its y is under 00A0 from the camera's), the x speed turned when it faces left, "INC #$29,X"
07E06F  func  enemy_defeated_launch
comment enemy_defeated_launch Launches the defeated enemy: shown with its shadow and not hit any more, the hit's sound, up at z speed 0200, along the floor at y speed 0100 (the other way, and for less time, when its y is less than 00A0 from the camera's), across the way it was knocked.
# 07E0AC "SUBD #$0020" gravity, landed: action 5 (it blinks out); 078638 the floor under it: none, flags 80, zoom
# 40/40, priority 20 when its y speed is not negative, the next step
07E0AC  func  enemy_defeated_fly
comment enemy_defeated_fly Flies the defeated enemy: when it lands it blinks out; when it is over a place with no floor it starts going into the distance, without its shadow, at the sprites' priority 20 when its y speed is not negative.
# 07E0EC z speed down to FC00 at most, 07E0FC "DEC #$3B,X; BNE" (the end: "CLR #$00,X; LBSR $8599"), under 18
# frames y speed 0, flags 90 (zoomed), 07E118 "ADDD #$0101" to the zoom; 07E124 "CMPA #$40" the sound 0301
07E0EC  func  enemy_defeated_shrink
comment enemy_defeated_shrink Lets the defeated enemy fall into the distance, smaller each frame for its last 18 frames, with the falling sound at 40; at the end it is gone and its points scored.
# action 0B: 07E12F "LDU #$F27A" steps 07E135, 07E0AC, 07E0EC
07E12F  func  enemy_defeated_backward
comment enemy_defeated_backward Action 0B: the enemy defeated from the front is knocked backwards and away, by its step.
# 07E135 "LDA #$8C; STA #$05,X", "LDD #$FF80; STD #$0F,X", "LBRA $E06F"
07E135  func  enemy_defeated_backward_start
comment enemy_defeated_backward_start Starts the backward knock: animation 8C and x speed 0080 backwards.
# action 0C (0785FC: no floor under it): 07E143 "LDU #$F280" steps 07E149, 07E155
07E143  func  enemy_pit
comment enemy_pit Action 0C: the enemy over a place with no floor falls into the pit, by its step.
# 07E149 "LDA #$40; STA #$3B,X; CLR #$1B,X; INC #$29,X"
07E149  func  enemy_pit_start
comment enemy_pit_start Starts the fall into the pit: no vitality left, a time of 40 frames.
# 07E155 "DEC #$3B,X; BNE" (the end: gone and scored, 07E15D "LBSR $8599"), at 38 the sound 0301, z speed down 0040 a
# frame to FC00 at most, below the floor (z negative) priority 20
07E155  func  enemy_pit_fall
comment enemy_pit_fall Drops the enemy into the pit, with the falling sound, at the sprites' priority 20 once below the floor; at the end it is gone and its points scored.

# ======== kind 90's effect (objects/fireman_goon_effect) ========
# list 1 type 04 (F40D) and list 2 type 13 (F4F4): 07E18F "LDU #$F28C; ASLB; JMP [B,U]" (07E195, 07E1A4); put in by
# 0785F0 (the child record fireman_goon_effect_child)
07E18F  func  fireman_goon_effect
comment fireman_goon_effect The object that shows kind 90's animation 11 once, by its state.
# 07E195 "LDU #$F290; LBSR $D132" (fireman_goon_effect_setup: kind 90, animation 11, an empty hit box), "LDA #$80; STA
# #$00,X", "INC #$02,X"
07E195  func  fireman_goon_effect_start
comment fireman_goon_effect_start Sets it up (kind 90, animation 11) and shows it.
# 07E1A4 "LDA #$06,X; LSRA; BCC; CLR #$00,X"
07E1A4  func  fireman_goon_effect_wait
comment fireman_goon_effect_wait Removes it once its animation has run to its end.

# ======== the enemies' own hit reaction (enemies/hurt) ========
# 07E1AE "LDA #$09,X; STA #$47,X", 07E1B4 "LBSR $D450" (object_setup_07F1A8: kind 80, the goon), animation 8D, time 18,
# state 4, action 4 (lying, then up: 07DF4C)
07E1AE  func  enemy_hurt_become_goon
comment enemy_hurt_become_goon Turns the enemy into a plain goon (kind 80, the goon's behaviour) lying on the ground, which then gets up and fights on.
# step 0 (loaded_table_07F29E's first): 07E1E8 "LDD #$6300; LBSR $97D3", "LDA #$1B,X; BNE" (none: step 2), the hit's
# animation 07E1FB "LDU #$F2AC" by field action (hit_animations), actions 0-1 a flinch (step 1), else z speed 0400,
# x speed 2 away from the hitter (by its x speed, or its place: 07E21B-07E240), step 5
07E1E8  func  enemy_hurt_start
comment enemy_hurt_start Starts the reaction to a hit: the hit's sound and the hit animation of its action; a flinch for actions 0 and 1, else knocked up and away from the hitter; with no vitality left, the defeat.
# step 1: 07E247 "LDA #$06,X; LSRA; BCC", "LDA #$C0; STA #$00,X", "LDY #$48,X" its hit box again, state 2
07E247  func  enemy_hurt_recover
comment enemy_hurt_recover Once the hit animation has run, gives the enemy its hit box back and sends it back to its state 2.
# step 2: 07E25C "LBSR $D16E; BCC" (landed: stops, animation 88 lying, the next step)
07E25C  func  enemy_hurt_fall_defeated
comment enemy_hurt_fall_defeated Lets the defeated enemy fall; once it lands it lies down.
# step 3: 07E270 "LDA #$06,X; LSRA" (the animation over: 07E276 "LDA #$43,X; BNE", 0 07E1AE, else time 10 and the next
# step), 07E289 "ANDA #$02" its marked frame: 07E290 "LDD #$4C,X; LBSR $97D3"
07E270  func  enemy_hurt_lie_defeated
comment enemy_hurt_lie_defeated Keeps the defeated enemy lying until its animation is over, with its sound on the marked frame; then it gets up as a plain goon, or (field vanishes) it starts to blink out.
# step 4: 07E299 "DEC #$3B,X; BNE" (the end: "CLR #$00,X; LBRA $D0E0"), 07E2A4 "LDA #$00,X; EORA #$80" ... "ORA #$04"
07E299  func  enemy_hurt_vanish
comment enemy_hurt_vanish Blinks the defeated enemy out; at the end it is gone and its points scored.
# step 5: 07E2AF "LBSR $D16E; BCC", "CLRW #$0F,X; LDA #$10; STA #$3B,X; INC #$29,X"
07E2AF  func  enemy_hurt_fall
comment enemy_hurt_fall Lets the knocked enemy fall; once it lands it stays down for 10 frames.
# step 6: 07E2C0 "DEC #$3B,X; BNE", "LDY #$48,X; LBSR $D1B7", "LDA #$C0; STA #$00,X", animation 8F, step 1
07E2C0  func  enemy_hurt_get_up
comment enemy_hurt_get_up After its time down, the knocked enemy gets up (animation 8F) with its hit box back.

# ======== the work RAM's variables ========
# Direct page 48 throughout ("<$NN" is 48NN). Those of the system, the coins, the queues, the camera and the scrolls,
# the sprites and the RAM checks.

# the game's state, by which the IRQ runs a routine (07913A "LDA <$00; ASLA; LDX #$E42B; JSR [A,X]"): 0 the test mode
# (07904E "STD <$00" when the test switch is pressed), 1 the attract (078966 "LDA #$01; STA <$00" at the boot's end), 2
# the game (079EC3 "LDA #$02; STA <$00" when a credit starts it)
4800  var  game_mode  u8
# the state's scene: the test mode's start and run (079187 "LDA <$01; ASLA; JMP [A,X]"), the attract's scenes (079E39
# by it; 079F24 "INC <$01" the next one)
4801  var  mode_step  u8
# the scene's step (079EF2 "INC <$02"; the attract's scenes and the game's routine 07A396 switch on it)
4802  var  mode_phase  u8
# the step of the story (1 story, 2 stage 1, 3 bonus 1 ... 16 the ending): 079ADD "LDA <$03; LDA A,X" (step_sprite_
# priorities), 07BA87 "LDA <$03" (step_scenes), 07A75E "INC <$03" the next step; in the attract the opening's step
# (079F08: bank 20's 6000 by it)
4803  var  game_step  u8
# the step's state: the routines of each step switch on it (bank 20's 040021 "LDA <$04; ASLA; JMP [A,X]"), cleared with
# the next step (07A764 "STA <$04")
4804  var  step_phase  u8
# the attract's scenes' wait (07A009 and 07A026 "DEC <$09"; 079F58 clears it: 256 frames)
4809  var  attract_timer  u8
# the bank in the window, for the interrupts to put back (every "STB <$0E; SETLN <$0E", the profile's BANK_SHADOW)
480E  var  window_bank  u8
# the copy of the board's register 1FC2 (bit 0 the palette RAM at 0000, bit 1 the sprite RAM at 2000, bit 2 the
# FIRQ, bits 3/4/7 the EEPROM): 0787FF "STA <$0F" with each "STA $1FC2"
480F  var  board_control  u8
# the copy of 1FC0 (bits 0-1 the coin counters: 078FAB "ORA #$01", 078FD4 "ANDA #$FD"; bit 2 from the setting 59F9:
# 078ACD; 30 the rest: 078AD4 "STA <$10")
4810  var  board_output  u8
# 1 while the attract runs (079E39 "LDA #$01; STA <$11", 079EAD "CLR <$11" as the game starts): the controls are the
# demo's (079248 "LDA <$11; BNE"), the sounds only with the setting (0797D8 "TST <$11"), the test switch clears it
# (07904B "STA <$11")
4811  var  in_attract  u8
# set while an IRQ's work runs (079088 "STA <$12" ... 079180 "CLR <$12"): another IRQ meanwhile only sends a sound
# command (079074 "LDA <$12; BEQ")
4812  var  irq_busy  u8
# the setting "sound in attract mode" (078A5C "LDA #$05,X; STA <$13"; 0797DD "TST <$13")
4813  var  attract_sound  u8
# the setting of the difficulty (078A56 "LDA #$03,X; STA <$14"; bank 20's rank_base by it: 040C65 "LDA <$14")
4814  var  difficulty_setting  u8
# the frames since the boot (079083 "INCW <$15")
4815  var  frame_count  u16
# the coin slots' records, 8 bytes from 4817 (0791F7 by U: 079005 "LDU #$4817", 079012 "LDU #$481F", 079024 "LDU
# #$4827", 079031 "LDU #$482F"): the slot's credits (when each slot has its own: 079239 "ADDD #$00,U", 079E39), the
# coins towards a credit (+2), the coin counter's pulses to give (+3: the IRQ's 078F9E "TST <$1A", 078FA3 "DEC <$1A"), the
# pulse's time (+4: 078F7D "TST <$1B", 8 frames a pulse), the coins a credit takes (+5) and the credits they give (+6,
# 078A26-078A34 from coinages for slots 1 and 2), whether the slot gave a credit already (+7: 079244 "STA #$07,U")
4817  var  slot_credits  u16
4819  var  slot_1_coins  u8
481A  var  slot_1_counter_pulses  u8
481B  var  slot_1_counter_time  u8
481C  var  slot_1_coins_per_credit  u8
481D  var  slot_1_credits_per_coins  u8
481E  var  slot_1_credit_given  u8
481F  var  slot_2_credits  u16
4822  var  slot_2_counter_pulses  u8
4823  var  slot_2_counter_time  u8
4824  var  slot_2_coins_per_credit  u8
4825  var  slot_2_credits_per_coins  u8
4827  var  slot_3_credits  u16
482F  var  slot_4_credits  u16
# the credits shared by the players when the slots are not each the player's (079214 "ADDD <$37; STD <$37"; 079E46
# "LDD <$37"; 07B739 "LDD <$37")
4837  var  credits  u16
# the setting 59F8 at 0 (078A42-078A4C): four coin slots, each a player's with its own credits (the IRQ reads slots 3
# and 4: 079018 "LDA <$39; BEQ"; 0791FA "LDA <$3B" the slot's own credits; 079E41 "LDA <$3B"), and a single coin
# counter (078FBB "LDA <$39; BNE": the second counter only without)
4839  var  four_coin_slots  u8
483B  var  separate_coin_slots  u8
# the setting 59FA: coins more for a slot's first credit (078ADA "STA <$3A"; 079226 "ADDA <$3A" while +7 is clear)
483A  var  first_credit_extra_coins  u8
# the coin inputs (1F80 inverted, a bit a slot: 078F6F "LDA $1F80; COMA; STA <$3D"), last frame's (078F69 "LDA <$3D;
# STA <$3E") and the frame's before (078F63 "LDA <$3E; STA <$3F"): a coin is counted once released (0791DA-0791E4)
483D  var  coin_inputs  u8
483E  var  coin_inputs_last  u8
483F  var  coin_inputs_before  u8
# the players' controls, 4 bytes a player (079095 "LDX #$4840", 07909E "LDX #$4844" ...): this frame's, last frame's,
# the newly pressed, the held (07924D-079265)
4840  var  player_controls[16]  u8
# the players in the game, a bit each (07978C "LDB <$50"; the demo's 07A0AF "STA <$50"; 079EB0 "CLR <$50")
4850  var  players_playing  u8
# the coins that went through the slots this frame (078F60 "CLR <$51", 0791EE "INC <$51"; 079E64 "LDA <$51": the
# attract jumps to its scene 5)
4851  var  coins_inserted  u8
# the copy of the K053246's register 5 (1FA5: bit 4 its IRQ, which starts the sprite DMA; bits 0-1 flipped): 078808
# "STA <$55" with each "STA $1FA5"
4855  var  sprite_chip_control  u8
# set when the frame's sprites are written (079135 "LDA #$01; STA <$56"), cleared by the FIRQ once the DMA took them
# (0791D4 "CLR <$56"); the IRQ waits for it (079130 "LDA <$56; BNE"), the boot too (078814)
4856  var  dma_pending  u8
# the random number (079548 "LDD <$58" ... "ADDD #$3711; STD <$58"; read as a byte by the banks: "LDA <$58")
4858  var  random_number  u8
# the lives a player starts with: the setting 59F5 plus one (078A4F "LDA #$04,X; INCA; STA <$5A"; 07B76F "ADDA <$5A")
485A  var  lives_per_credit  u8
# the screen clears queued and not done yet (0797BA "INC <$5D" for job 0, 07980E "CLR <$5D" when it ran; 079EF6 "LDA
# <$5D; BNE" waits)
485D  var  layer_clear_pending  u8
# the setting "video screen flip" (078AAC "STA <$5F"; 07961A "LDA <$5F": the sprite chip's offsets)
485F  var  flip_screen  u8
# the colour job 1 prints in (079824 "STB <$71", 07981E "LDA <$71")
4871  var  text_colour  u8
# the map's scene and its area (079EFE "STD <$75", 07C931 by them: the tile banks; symbols.txt's scene tables by
# direct page 75 and 76)
4875  var  map_scene  u8
4876  var  map_area  u8
# the frames counted before a button may skip (079784 "CMPA <$78", 0797AD "INC <$78", 0797B2 "CLR <$78")
4878  var  skip_wait  u8
# when set, the sprites are left as they are (079841 "LDA <$79; BNE"; 07B45A "STA <$79")
4879  var  objects_frozen  u8
# the kind of palette job 07BAC7 starts (079041 "STA <$7E"; symbols.txt's palette_request_handlers by direct page 7E)
487E  var  palette_request_kind  u8
# the K053246's scroll registers' copies (1FA0, 1FA2: 078A87 "STD <$86", 078A91 "STD <$89"), by the flip setting
4886  var  sprite_scroll_x  u16
4889  var  sprite_scroll_y  u16
# the camera's place in the stage, across and on the floor (16.8): a spawn's x less it (07CA07 "SUBD <$AC"), its y
# with it (07CA28 "ADDD <$B2"); the floor map by it (079501 "ADDD <$AC", 079532 "ADDD <$B2"); the IRQ keeps last
# frame's (07910C-07911E)
48AC  var  camera_x  u16
48B2  var  camera_y  u16
# the camera's speeds (bank 13: "LDD <$DE" ... added to 48AC; 0798F5 "LDD <$DE; BMI", 07990E "LDD <$E0")
48DE  var  camera_x_speed  s16
48E0  var  camera_y_speed  s16
# the tile layers' scrolls (layers' layer_map records: 2800 48BE 48C5 ... and 3000 48CE 48D5): the IRQ writes them to
# the K052109 (0790B6 "LDD <$BE; SUBD #$005A" into 1A00, 0790C4 "LDB <$C6" into 180C, 0790DD "LDD <$CE" into 3A00,
# 0790EB "LDB <$D6" into 380C) and keeps them as last frame's (0790F4-079109 "STD <$C1", "STD <$C8", "STD <$D1", "STD
# <$D8"; layer_map's last_scroll_y names 48C8 and 48D8)
48BE  var  layer_a_scroll_x  u16
48C1  var  layer_a_last_scroll_x  u16
48C5  var  layer_a_scroll_y  u16
48C8  var  layer_a_last_scroll_y  u16

48D1  var  layer_b_last_scroll_x  u16
48D5  var  layer_b_scroll_y  u16
48D8  var  layer_b_last_scroll_y  u16
# the queue of sound commands for the Z80 (0797ED "LDX $4900; STD ,X++", 4904-493F round; the IRQ sends one a frame:

4900  var  sound_queue_write  u16
4902  var  sound_queue_read  u16
4904  var  sound_queue[30]  u16
# the main loop's jobs (0797B7 "LDX $4940; STD ,X++", 4944-497F round; 0789CB "LDX $4942; LDD ,X; BMI": FFFF none)
4940  var  job_queue_write  u16
4942  var  job_queue_read  u16
4944  var  job_queue[30]  u16
# the high score table, 10 records of 8 bytes (07893E "LDU #$4980", 50 bytes from default_high_scores; 07971D "LDX
# #$4983" their scores)
4980  var  high_scores[80]  u8
# the players' scores, BCD words (the score jobs: 079828 "LDX #$49D4", 07982E "LDX #$49DC", 079834 "LDX #$49E4",
# 07983A "LDX #$49EC"; player_records' field 09)
49D4  var  marge_score  u16
49DC  var  homer_score  u16
49E4  var  bart_score  u16
49EC  var  lisa_score  u16
# the RAM test's start (078DD2 "STU $5D00"), whether a check failed (078E81 "ORB $5D02; STB $5D02"; the restart at
# 078D82), and each chip's result for the screen (078B38 "STB $5D04" ... the EEPROM's 5D09; 5D03 the work RAM's, which
# the boot tested already)
5D00  var  ram_test_start  u16
5D02  var  check_failed  u8
5D03  var  check_11f  u8
5D04  var  check_1j  u8
5D05  var  check_16g  u8

# ======== the fixed program, 07A000-07BFFF ========
# ======== the fixed program 07A000-07BFFF: the attract's screens, the game's phases and steps, the players, the
# palette jobs (proposals for symbols.txt; fixed_3D.c) ========
# Evidence quotes are the listing's (build\listing\simpsons.s); the tables of handlers were read from the ROM:
# - game_mode's handlers E42B: 9184 (0, the test mode: bank 2F's 6009), 9E39 (1, the attract), A396 (2, the game)
#   (07913A "LDA <$00; ASLA; LDX #$E42B; JSR [A,X]")
# - the attract's steps E66B by attract_step (079E7F "LDX #$E66B; LDA <$01"): 9EDA profiles, A075 demo, 9F36 title,
#   A209 high scores, A2CD warning, A34E the title after a coin; each step's phases by mode_phase: E677, E687 (A07E
#   A12B), E67F (9F3F 9F52 A007 A024), E68B (A212 A240 A28C A29B), E693 (A2D6 A2EB A314 A329), E69B (A357 A35F A384)
# - the game's phases E6CB by mode_phase (07A3B0 "LDX #$E6CB; LDA <$02"): A3C0 start, A415 the steps, B458 continue,
#   B464 game over, B4F5 name entry
# - the game's steps E6D9 by game_step (07A415 "LDX #$E6D9; LDA <$03"): A41E (0 portraits), A4CE (1 story 1), A52E (2
#   stage 1), A656 (3 bonus 1), A76D (4 stage 2), A8AE (5 story 2), A8B8 (6 stage 3 forest), AA0C (7 stage 3
#   cemetery), AB4F (8 stage 4), AC74 (9 stage 5), ADC4 (10 story 3), ADD2 (11 stage 6), AF20 (12 bonus 2), B068 (13
#   stage 7), B1D4 (14 story 4), B1DE (15 stage 8), B40A (16 the ending); each step's phases by step_phase: E6FB, E701,
#   E707, E717, E721, E731, E743, E751, E761, E773, E785, E791, E7A3, E7C1 (in that order)
# - the map scenes each stage sets (direct page 75): 82 stage 1, 83 bonus 1, 84 stage 2, 86 forest, 87 cemetery, 88
#   stage 4, 89 stage 5, 8A stage 6, 8B bonus 2, 8C stage 7, 8D stage 8, 03 the name entry, 02 the high scores
# - songs (assets/sound_data/music/music.txt): 87 bonus_start, 90 name_entry, 92 game_over, 94 stage_3_part_1_end,
#   A1 continue; command 00 stops the sound
# Sound commands go through 0797ED (always), 0797E3 (not in the attract) or 0797D3 (in the attract only with its demo
# sounds); 0797B7 queues a job of the main loop (A = 0: job 0, the tile layers' clear, which layer_clear_pending
# counts: 0797BA "INC <$5D", 07980E "CLR <$5D"); 079784 waits A frames, then a press of a button skips (carry set)

# ======== the fixed program, 07C000-07DFFF ========
# ======== fixed_3E.c (the fixed program 07C000-07DFFF): names proposed by this part ========
# Evidence: build\listing\simpsons.s (quoted instructions), build\decompile\index.txt (callers), the ROM's tables
# (dumped with simpsons_rom.build_program). Object fields are written by offset (field 1B and so on) where the common
# `field object` lines are named elsewhere; the report lists what this file shows about the common fields.
#
# Common object fields this file establishes (the `field object` lines declare them):
# 02 the object's state (each list's dispatcher passes it to the handler: 07CB6F "LDD #$01,X" type and state, the goon's
# 07D40A "LDU #$F19C; ASLB; JSR [B,U]"); 06 bit 0 the animation ended (07DDDE "LDA #$06,X; LSRA; BCC"), bit 7 set on
# landing (07D1A4); 09 bit 6 faces left, bits 4-5 the priority from the floor map; 0C x, 11 y (bigger is further back:
# higher on the screen, 079C53 sprite y = 11 + 16 + offset, drawn upside down by the K053247), 16 z (height), 0F/14/19
# their speeds; 1B life; 1C the power its hit box takes off (07C277 "SUBA #$1C,U"); 1D the kind of hit it gives (07C28A
# "LDA #$1D,U; STA #$1E,X"); 1E the strongest kind of hit it took this frame; 1F/20/21 the box's half width (x), depth
# (y) and height (z) (07C155, 07C1A7, 07C1CF); 22 the box's x offset, mirrored when it faces left (07C162-07C176); 23
# its y offset (07C13A "LDB #$23,X; SEX; ADDD #$11,X"); 24 its z offset (07C1B5); 25 the object that hit it (07C290 "STU
# #$25,X"); 27 the score: bits 0-3 its points (from its setup), bits 4-5 the player who hit it last (07CFC2 "LDA #$5B,U;
# ANDA #$70"), bit 7 defeated (07D0E0), read by 07BA5D-07BA7B; 30 the state a spawn gives it (07C9FE); 31 the floor
# contact bits (check_floor, below); 40 the parent of a child object (07CAAB "STX #$40,U"); 42 bit 7 not counted as an
# enemy (07CB84), non-zero: has the walk animations by direction (07D7DA); 45 the floor level of the step ahead
# (07CEB3); 46 the floor map's cell under it (07CE10); 47 the cell where it is going (07CE3E); 48 its hit box's address
# (07D141 "STY #$48,X"); 57 (07CB8D, counted into 1883 when 0); 59-5A the object's sprite RAM place, kept when its slot
# is cleared (07CA64 "LDD #$59,U" ... "STD #$59,U"; 079572 "STU #$-07,X" sets it); 5C-5D its floor's height (07CA3E
# "STD #$5C,U", 07CE18 "STA #$5D,X").
#
# Flags (field 00) bits seen here: 80 on, 40 in the hit checks (07C045 "BITA #$40"), 20 hit this frame (07C296), 08 in
# the air (07CE04), 04 takes no damage (07C270 "ANDA #$04"), 02 a player attacking (07C2D5; bank 1C 03889A "ORA #$02"
# with its attack box); 07CA7B "LDB #$04; STB #$00,U" marks a slot just taken.

# ======== the background maps ========
# The map's layout (data_walk.py's map walk): a scene's area points at strips of 256 pixels, each a list of rows of 16
# bytes (8 cells of a 10-bit block number); a block is 18 bytes: its colour, its floor pattern (16 bytes in
# block_tile_flags, 4 x 4 cells) and its 4 x 4 tiles. The floor map is 64 cells a row at 4000, one byte a cell of 8
# pixels: the floor's height in steps of 8 (low nibble), the sprites' priority (bits 4-5), no floor (bit 7): 079540
# "LDU #$4000; LEAU D,U; LDA ,U" (078638 reads it under an object).

# ======== the program's data this file reads ========

# an object's setup (data_walk.py ARGUMENT_RECORDS "object setup", 6 bytes): 07D137 "LDD ,U; ORB #$80; STD #$04,X" its
# kind and animation, 07D13E "LDY #$02,U; STY #$48,X; LBSR $D1B7" its hit box, 07D147 "LDA #$04,U; STA #$1B,X" its life,
# 07D14D "LDA #$05,U; ANDA #$7F; STA #$27,X" its points (07BA69 "ANDA #$0F" the score it gives)
struct object_setup 06 rom
# the kind (high byte, the sprite set) and the animation (low byte), read as one word
field object_setup 00 kind_and_animation u16
field object_setup 02 box u16 hit_box
field object_setup 04 life u8
field object_setup 05 points u8
# the goon's: 07D416 / 07D450 "LDU #$F1A8" (80 01 F13C 08 01), its box (10 04 20 00 00 20 00 00) and its behaviour
# (07D42F "LDU #$F144; STU #$2A,X": 88 bytes up to F19B, where its state table starts)
07F1A8  table  goon_setup[1]  object_setup
07F13C  table  goon_hit_box[1]  hit_box
07F144  table  goon_behaviour[1]  enemy_behaviour

# 0 when close behind a target that faces away, 80 otherwise (07D3CD "CLR #$32,X", 07D3D1 "LDA #$80; STA #$32,X")
scoped object enemy 32 not_behind_target u8
# the quarter its walk animation was picked for (07D270 "ANDA #$C0; STA #$34,X")
scoped object enemy 34 walk_quarter u8
# the direction to the target the moves aimed by (07D2A5 "STA #$35,X", 07D84E "CMPA #$35,X")
scoped object enemy 35 aimed_direction u8
# bit 7: which of its target's two attack slots it holds (07D547 "ORA #$80; STA #$37,X", 07D118 "LDA #$37,X; BPL")
scoped object enemy 37 side u8
# 07D815 "STB #$3C,X" (3 tries round), 07DD86 "STB #$3C,X" (4 paces)
scoped object enemy 3C count u8
# the way round its target: 07D81E-07D82A "LDA <$58; BPL; CLR #$3D,X" / "LDA #$FF; STA #$3D,X", 07DC74 "LDB #$3D,X; BNE"
scoped object enemy 3D way_round u8

# ======== banks 10-12 ========
# Names for banks 10, 11, 12 (places 020000-025FFF): the two bonus stages and their results, stage 1's boss (the
# wrestler), the speech balloon, the high score table and the name entry, the ending, stage 7's boss and its helpers,
# and the scripted scenes that end the stages. symbols.txt syntax.
#
# Evidence used throughout (checked in build/listing/simpsons.s and the ROM):
# - Which scenario runs what: build/scenarios/<scenario>/executed.txt. Bonus 1 runs in stage1 and bonus1 (the step
#   after stage 1), bonus 2 in stage6 and bonus2 (the step after stage 6), the wrestler in stage1 and buy_in, stage 7's
#   boss in stage7 only, the ending's code in stage8, the high score table in attract (its first five lines also at
#   the end of stage8), the name entry in none (no scenario makes a high score).
# - The scene each scripted scene shows: the background scene (direct page 75) it sets: 82 stage 1 Downtown, 83 bonus 1,
#   84 stage 2 Krustyland, 89 stage 5 the gorge, 8A stage 6 Dreamland, 8B bonus 2, 8C stage 7 Channel 6, 8D stage 8
#   the power plant, 8E the ending (tools/extract_assets.py SCENE_NAMES), and the step code that calls each entry of
#   bank 12 (07A5FB stage 1's step, 07A876 stage 2's, 07AD8F stage 5's, 07AE1A / 07AEBE / 07AEEE stage 6's, 07B039 the
#   bonus 2 step's, 07B14C / 07B19B stage 7's, 07B228 / 07B3DC stage 8's).
# - The fixed program's routines these banks call, by what they do: 078680 (0797D3) and 078689 (0797E3) queue a sound
#   command for the Z80 (4900 ring; 078689 not during the demo, direct page 11), 07869E (0797ED) queues it always;
#   078656 (0797B7) queues a job (4940 ring); 078677 (07BAC7) a palette request of the kind in direct page 7E; 07868C
#   (07955F) clears all the objects; 07868F (0792DD) clears the sprite RAM; 0786C2 / 0786C5 (07B632 / 07B64C) set the
#   layers' x / y scroll; 0786AD (07C4A3) draws a layer's map; 0786B0 (07C931) sets the K052109's layer modes by the
#   scene and area; 07867D (07CA54) takes a free object of the given list; 07862C (07CA8A) puts a child object; 0785B1
#   (07D16E) applies gravity down to the floor (carry: landed); 078617 (07CC8E) sets the speeds from a direction and a
#   speed; 07861D (07CCFB) the direction from X's object to U's; 078671 (07CCF0) the same to a point beside U's;
#   078686 (07D2AB) the nearest player present (carry: one); 0786BF (07E496) draws a boss's 5-piece health gauge.
# - Object fields read the same way as the other banks (the common fields): 00 flags (bit 4: drawn zoomed by
#   fields 0A/0B: 079C37 "LDA #$00,X; BITA #$10; LBNE $9CD4", the zoomed sprites), 02 state (signed), 04 kind, 05
#   animation, 06 bit 0 animation ended / bit 1 a marked frame, 09 attributes (bit 6 facing), 0A/0B zoom, 0C x, 11 y,
#   16 height, 0F/14/19 their speeds, 1B health, 1C-23 the hit box, 1E the hit's kind, 25 the attacker, 27 the
#   scoring player's bits, 28 sub-step, 29 a countdown, 2B the target.

# ======== banks 13-14 ========
# ======== names for banks 13 and 14 (026000-029FFF): proposal for symbols.txt ========
# Places are offsets of the program region; quotes are the listing's (build\listing\simpsons.s) instructions, by place.
# "ran" / "never ran": build\decompile\index.txt's count of instructions the 25 scenarios run.
#
# Who is who (evidence used below):
# - Bank 13's jump table: 026000 list 0 type 05 (07CB3C, the krusty balloon, stage 2's boss: kind 9D, SET_NAMES
#   krusty_balloon); 026003 list 1 type 31 and list 2 type 10 (what the balloon throws: 0269E0 puts one in list 1 with
#   type 31, 0269F4 "LDA #$31", else list 2 with type 10, 0269F0 "LDA #$10"); 026006 the steps' starts (07A563,
#   07A7A2 ... 07B219: substep 0 of each stage's step): the title cards; 026009 every playing step's frame (07A4F4,
#   07A5FB ...): the screen shake and the scrolling; 02602A steps 1 and 7's starts (07A427, 07AA3E); 02602D step 1
#   (07A4F4: runs it until it clears direct page 72, then "INC <$03"): story 1, the opening; 026030 list 1 type ED and
#   026033 list 2 type 1F: the door stage 3's boss comes out of (below).
# - Bank 14: the goons (kinds 80 goon, 84 goon_with_hat, 82 goon_with_umbrella, 83 goon_with_shovel, B6), by their
#   type in list 0 (07CB6C "LDU #$F387" banks, 07CB7E "LDU #$F2EC" handlers), and the enemy actions (field 28) whose
#   bank byte (action_banks, 07F620) is 14. Each type's handler: "LDU #table; ASLB; JSR [B,U]" by its state (field 02),
#   then 0785B7 (off the screen) and 078596 (the hit reaction); states 2-5 are the fixed program's enemy states
#   (0785DB choose, 0785DE run the action, 0785E1 hurt, 0785E4), state 0 the type's set-up and state 1 its entrance (by
#   field 29). Each action's handler: "LDU #table; ASLB; JMP [B,U]" by field 29, B from 07D64F "LDD #$28,X".
# - Which actions a goon picks: its behaviour (field 2A, enemy_behaviour: 4 ranges of 12 bytes from 28, by the x
#   distance in field 2D: the 2F limit, the 2D range, a chance, 4 actions and their weights; 07D3D7, 07D5C0-07D5EA).
#   Bank 14's behaviours: 029808 (type 03: close 02/0F, mid 00/01, far 18/03/04), 029860 (types 0C, 34, F4, EE: close
#   02,
#   mid 03, far 18/27/04: no grab), 0298B8 (type EB: close 02/0F, mid 00/18, far 01/18/04), 029910 (type E7: close
#   00/02, mid 03/3D, far 27), 029CDF (type 3B: close 00/02, mid 03/04, far 04/1B/27), 029D37 (goon_with_hat: 00 02 01
#   04 06), 029D8F (goon_with_umbrella: 16 11 13 12), 029DE7 (goon_with_shovel: 33 14 15).
# - Kind 9C is Smithers': the set of stage 8's first boss (type F6, 03A2AA "LDA #$9C; STA #$04,X"), and in story 1 it
#   runs in, stops by the family and runs off with two goons (027689 below). Its set also holds a crash (animation 8A
#   with sound 6F00: 02933A, 0277B8).

# ======== banks 15-17 ========
# ======== banks 15, 16, 17: names of the functions, files, families' fields and work RAM variables ========
# Places are offsets of the program region; evidence quotes are the
# listing's (build\listing\simpsons.s) or the C's (src\unsorted\bank_1X.c, OBJECT(x)->unk_NN written @NN here).
#
# How each handler was told apart (common evidence for everything below):
# - The object lists' dispatchers pick a bank and a handler by the object's type (field 01): list 0 = 4F80 (07CB6C
#   "LDU #$F387" / 07CB7E "LDU #$F2EC"), list 1 = 5280 (07CBAD "LDU #$F4B0" / 07CBBF "LDU #$F40D"), list 2 = 4D40
#   (07CBE0 "LDU #$F54C" / 07CBF2 "LDU #$F4F4"), list 3 = 5640 (07CC0F "LDU #$F581" / 07CC21 "LDU #$F577"), and the
#   enemies' actions by field 28 (07D64C "LDU #$F620" / 07D65E "LDU #$F5A2"). A small script over the ROM image read
#   those tables: e.g. list 0 type FB -> bank 15 6000 = 02A000; each "list N type T" below is that.
# - The stages a type is put in: assets/data/spawns.txt (spawn_lists[scene], the list in the spawn's flags bits 2-3),
#   "sN" = scene N (0 stage 1, 1 stage 2, 3/4 stage 3 forest/cemetery, 5 stage 4, 6 stage 5, 8 stage 6, 9 stage 7,
#   B stage 8).
# - The kind (field 04, the sprite set) from the setup each start step loads ("LDU #$xxxx; LBSR $85AB" -> 07D132
#   "LDD ,U; ORB #$80; STD #$04,X"), named as tools/extract_assets.py SET_NAMES names it (kind_XX where it does not).
# - Each type's handler (the LBRA at the bank's start, with the code it jumps to) switches on the object's step
#   (field 02: the dispatcher's "LDD #$01,X" leaves it in B, "ASLB; JSR [B,U]"); a step's own substeps go by field
#   29 (or 28, or 37). An enemy's steps 2-5 are the fixed program's shared fight (sub_0785DB -> 07D49C picks an
#   action, sub_0785DE -> 07D63B runs it, sub_0785E1 / sub_0785E4 / sub_07865C the reactions), then sub_078596
#   (07D056, the hit reaction) and sub_0785B7 (07D1F7, gone past x 01C0).
# - Fixed-program helpers the steps call, as the listing shows them: sub_0785AB (07D132: the object setup), sub_0785B4
#   (07D1B7: a hit box into fields 1C-24), sub_0785B1 (07D16E: gravity, carry when it lands), sub_078662 (07D1B0:
#   landing while falling), sub_0785C6 (07D232: face the x speed's way), sub_0785C9 (07D249: face the target by field
#   36), sub_07859C (07D0FC: face by field 36), sub_078620 (07D301: the nearest player into 38), sub_078626 (07D35B: the
#   distance and angle to it, fields 2C 2E 36), sub_078617 (07CC8E: speeds from a direction and a speed), sub_07861D
#   (07CCFB: the angle to another object), sub_078638 (079495: the floor cell under the object), sub_07863B / 078644 /
#   078647 (0794D9 / 0794B9 / 0794C9: the floor cell ahead), sub_078650 (07948C: the floor map cell's address),
#   sub_07862C (07CA8A: a child object from an 8-byte child_object record), sub_07862F (07CA9E: a child in list 2),
#   sub_078680 (0797D3: queue a sound), sub_078683 (07D1E3: gone off screen), sub_078674 (07C0E0: hurts the enemies
#   it touches), sub_078593 (07CF97: what a player's hit does to it).

# ======== banks 18-1A ========
# Names for banks 18, 19, 1A (places 030000-035FFF): the object handlers by type, the enemies' actions, bosses.
# symbols.txt syntax. Evidence: the listing (build/listing/simpsons.s), the dispatcher tables of the fixed program
# (read from the ROM: 07CB6C/07CB7E "LDU #$F387 / #$F2EC" for 4F80, 07CBAD/07CBBF F4B0/F40D for 5280, 07CBE0/07CBF2
# F54C/F4F4 for 4D40, 07CC0F/07CC21 F581/F577 for 5640, 07D64C/07D65E F620/F5A2 for the actions by field 28), the
# setups (07D132 "LDD ,U; ORB #$80; STD #$04,X": the first byte of the record is the kind, the sprite set), the spawn
# lists (assets/data/spawns.txt; the scenes by step_scenes E88D: scene 0 stage 1, 1 stage 2, 3 stage 3 forest, 4
# cemetery, 5 stage 4, 6 stage 5, 8 stage 6, 9 stage 7, 11 stage 8), the behaviours (assets/data/objects.txt
# enemy_behaviour_*: the actions each enemy picks, bytes 28-57) and the sprite sheets (assets/sprites/).
#
# How a handler of these banks works (checked on each): the bank's jump table at 6000 (LBRA), one entry a type or an
# action; a type's handler runs a step routine by field 02 ("ASLB; JSR [B,U]" with D = "LDD #$01,X" from the
# dispatcher: B = field 02, signed: steps FE and FF are the ones the fixed program's hit routines set, 07CFDD "LDA
# #$FE" when the vitality (1B) is 0, 07CFE1 "LDA #$FF" otherwise), an action's handler (07D64F "LDD #$28,X") by field
# 29. The enemies' type handlers share one shape: step 0 their setup, 1 their way in, 2 the fixed program's 0785DB
# (07D49C: picks the player to go after, field 38, and the action by the behaviour in field 2A), 3 0785DE (07D63B: runs
# the action in field 28), 4 07865C (07E1D3: the shared hit reaction), 5 0785E4 (07D6B2), then 078596 (07D056: the
# enemy's hit check) and 0785B7 (07D1F7: removed past the screen's edge).
# Words in the comments: an object's field 05 is its animation (bit 7 starts it again), 06 bit 0 its animation ended
# and bit 1 a marked frame of it (the frame an attack hits on), 0C/11/16 its x, y and height, 0F/14/19 their speeds,
# 3B a countdown, 38 the player an enemy goes after, 2A its behaviour, 28/29 its action and the action's step.

# Places are the program's offsets; quotes are build/listing/simpsons.s's instructions. Who each object is comes from
# the list dispatchers' type tables (07CB6C/07CB7E 4F80, 07CBAD/07CBBF 5280, 07CBE0/07CBF2 4D40, read from the ROM):
# bank 1B: 5280 types 0C (6018), 0B (601B), 38 (601E), 2A (6021), 12 (6024); bank 1D: 4F80 F6 (6000), EC (6009), EA
# (6024); 5280 E2 (6027), E4 (6012), E5 (6015), E6 (6018), E7 (601B), F1 (6006); 4D40 1C (6003), 1D (6006), 21 (600F),
# 25 (6021), 26 (601E). Where each comes in: bank 1B's spawn_lists by scene (scene 0 stage 1, 5 stage 4, 9 stage 7,
# 11 stage 8), the list in a spawn's flags bits 2-3.

# ======== bank 1C: the players ========
# Bank 1C runs the 4 players' objects (4A40 + C0 x player, each with its second sprite at +60, bank 1F's). Every
# function gets the player's object in U (038003-038073 "LDU #$4A40 ... LDU #$4B00 ..."), not in X: the param lines
# below type it object.player so the C reads the player's fields by the scoped lines at the end of this section.
# A player's state is field 30, run through the table at 039D51 (038290 "LDB #$30,U; CLRA; ASLB; LDY #$7D51; JMP
# [D,Y]"; 64 entries, 7D51-7DD0, then states 40 and 41 at 7DD1/7DD3, the unreached_ handlers). States: 00 standing,
# 02 jump, 03 fall, 04/05 throwing what it carries, 06/07 swinging weapon 6/7, 08 throwing weapon 8, 09-0C the attack
# moves, 0D the jump kick, 0F/3C/3D/3E flung to the back, 0E/17/28 dropping after a crash, 11 squashed, 14 knocked
# flying, 15/16 knocked down, 18/19 knocked up, 1A/1B stunned, 1C grabbed, 1F losing a life, 20-22 the last life's
# end, 26/27 joining, 29 an attack's start, 2A a 32-frame pose, 2B throwing a weapon away, 2C working at a heavy object,
# 2D heaving it with another player, 2F lifting, 30-34 a team move, 35-38 team attacks, 3A/3B grabbed and hit,
# escaping; 01, 25, 2E, 39 (the team's passenger), 3F do nothing but keep the life in the record. Animations are the
# character's (field 04: 0 Marge, 1 Homer, 2 Bart, 3 Lisa) set's: 80 standing, 01/02 walking, B5-B8 the attacks, D0-DF
# the hit reactions.

# ---- the files ----
# (the line at 038000 replaces symbols.txt's "038000  file  unsorted/bank_1C")
038000  file  players/players    # the four players run each frame with their controls, and how a player joins the stage
0382B9  file  players/states    # the players' states: standing, walking, jumping, attacks, weapons, carrying, team moves, hit reactions, losing a life
0392F0  file  players/reactions    # what touches a player each frame: pickups, weapons, blows by their strength, another player's team-up
03978A  file  players/motion    # a player's motion against walls, floors, the screen's edges and the scroll, and helpers on its speeds and partner
039B0C  file  players/effects    # a player's blinking, hit sparks, balloons and voices: the second sprite at +60 and the sounds by character

# ---- running the players ----
# 038000 "LBRA $6003" (07B5DD, 07B676 call bank 1C's 6000): 038003 "CLR $184C; CLR $184D; CLRW <$E6", then for each
# player "LDA <$40; LDB <$42; PUSHS D; PULLS Y" (its controls and newly pressed ones), "LDU #$4A40; LDX #$49D0; STX
# $1848; LDD #$0100; LBSR $60AB" ... (4B00/49D8/0201, 4BC0/49E0/0402, 4C80/49E8/0803), then 038076 "CLR $184E; TST
# $184B" (a stage's end) "LDA $184C; CMPA #$04" (all four idle) "STA $184E", 038091-0380A0 "LDU #$3F,X ... CLR #$00,U"
038000  func  player_run_all
comment player_run_all Runs the four players' objects with their controls and records, adding their y scroll requests; at a stage's end, once all four stand idle, says so in 184E and removes the objects they carry.
local player_run_all 03808C,0380A3 x player object.player
# 0380AB "BITA <$50" (the player's bit in the players in the game), "TST #$03,X" (its record's: entered), 0380F7 the
# entry ("LDB #$34,U; LDA #$80; STA #$05,U", "LEAX #$1C,X; LDU #$003D; CLRA; BSET" clears 1C-58, "LDA #$28; STA
# #$1B,U", "STB #$5B,U; STB #$00BB,U" the player's number in both sprites, "LDB #$01; STB #$03,X"), by scene:
# 038151 "CMPA #$04 / #$0B" drops in from above (state 27, animation BB, 0381AB), else jumps in from the left (state 26,
# animation BA, 03822B "LDX #$0E00; STX #$0F,U"); 0380F1 "STY #$2E,U" (controls), 0380BB "TST $184B" (none at a
# stage's end), 038286 "INC #$4F,U" (up to 0E), 038290 the state table
0380AB  func  player_run
comment player_run Runs one player: when its record says it has not entered yet, sets it up afresh (full life unless it rejoins) and brings it in, jumping in from the left or dropping from above in scenes 4 and 0B, or blinking in place when it rejoins; then takes its controls (none at a stage's end, where its team-up is undone) and runs its state.
param player_run y controls
param player_run u player object.player
param player_run d bit_and_number
# 038200 "LDX #$0040; STX #$0C,U; CLR <$F3; LDA #$08", "LBSR $786D; BCS" (a wall), "CMPB <$F3; BLE; STB <$F3" (the
# highest floor), "LEAX #$08,X", "CLRA": the place it jumps in at (0381C3-0381FD try depths B8, B0 ... then C0 on)
038200  func  player_find_entry_floor
comment player_find_entry_floor Checks the 8 places 8 pixels apart from x 40 at the player's depth for a way in: carry when one is a wall; the highest floor met in F3.
param player_find_entry_floor u player object.player

# ======== banks 1E-2F ========
# ======== names for banks 1E, 1F, 20 and 2F (proposals for symbols.txt) ========
# Places 03C000-041FFF and 05E000-05FFFF. Evidence: build/listing/simpsons.s (quoted as PLACE "INSTRUCTION"),
# src/unsorted/bank_1E.c, bank_1F.c, bank_20.c, bank_2F.c, symbols.txt's tables, assets/ (texts, sprite sets, music).
# Who is who (evidence used by many entries below):
# - list dispatchers (07F387/07F2EC list 0 at 4F80, 07F4B0/07F40D list 1 at 5280, 07F54C/07F4F4 list 2 at 4D40,
#   07F581/07F577 list 3 at 5640), the bank byte then the handler word by the object's type: bank 1E's 6000 is list 0
#   type 19, 6003 list 2 type 05, 6006 list 2 type 06, 6009 list 0 type 20, 600C list 2 type 01 / list 0 type 0B /
#   list 1 type 0E, 600F list 2 type 08, 6012 list 1 type 35, 6015 list 0 E8 / list 1 E9 / list 2 2A, 6018 list 0 type
#   3E, 601B list 0 type F9, 601E list 1 type 36; bank 1F's 6006 list 2 type 0F, 6015 list 3 type 03, 6018 list 2 type
#   0C, 6021 list 1 type 1E, 6024 list 2 type 07, 6030 list 2 type 14, 6033 list 2 type 15.
# - child objects (07862C "LBRA $CA8A": 8-byte records dx, dy, dz, list, field 30, type; 07862F "LBRA $CA9E": 6 bytes,
#   list 2, type at byte 5); both store the parent in the child's field 40 (07CAAB "STX #$40,U").
# - songs (assets/sound_data/music/music.txt): 8000 attract, 9600 area_clear, 9800 boss_defeated.
# - the bosses' state is field 2E with its wait in 2F (03C04C "STY #$2E,X", 03C059 "STB #$2E,X; ASLB; LDD B,Y; STA
#   #$2F,X; STB #$05,X"), their tables of state handlers by 2E (football 7D70, bear 7DEC, stage 3's 7EDC, F9's 7F62).

# ======== the enemies' step tables and the robot's pieces ========
# ======== the enemies' step tables, by name ========
# Each move, reaction or climb runs by its step (field 29) through its own table: "LDU #$Fxxx; ASLB; JMP [B,U]"
# (or JSR) at its dispatcher. The tables lie one after another from F1BE to F2AB, and a routine's steps run on into
# the next table's on purpose: the enemy walking to its target (F1FE, 2 steps of its own) goes on at its step 2 with
# the steps of lining up with it (F202), stage 5 at frame 4925 ("LDU #$F1FE; ASLB; JMP [B,U]" with B = 3: 07DA1A).
# So no table here has a length (with one, that step did nothing): each switch keeps the next tables' entries as
# cases, which the game can reach. These lines name them only.
# 07D6B2 "LDU #$F1AE; LDD #$28,X; ASLA; JSR [A,U]": the climb or hop by the action (field 28), 8 of them up to F1BE

# ======== code and data still named after their address ========
# (merged without the lengths this part gave the tables of code addresses, record=2 count=N: a routine's steps run
# on into the next table's on purpose, see the enemies' step tables above; the analysis reads them as before)
# ======== the 053248's code and data still named after their place ========
# How each name reaches the C:
# - a data line (PLACE data NAME) names the piece the data walk starts there: extract_assets takes symbols.txt's names
#   for its pieces (analysis.symbols), so assets/data/layout.txt then holds NAME, and the decompiler names the data by
#   layout.txt (konami_cpu/decompile.py piece_names, which overrides symbols.txt's data names): extract_assets has to
#   run again after the merge, before decompile.py, or the C keeps the old names from the old layout.txt. A plain data
#   line changes nothing the walk or the analysis does (no length: analysis.layout_of is None).
# - a data line with record=2 count=N code=0 (the tables of code addresses) also gives the analysis the table's
#   length: it reads N entries, and no more the tables before and after it (their entries were cases of its switch:
#   wrestler_beaten's switch had the flinch's and the entrance's handlers). The piece is the same (the walk's loaded
#   table). Tables with entries before their address (negative states: the bosses' FD-FF) or past the next table get a
#   plain line, so the analysis still reads them both ways.
# - func lines replace symbols.txt's func line at the same place (unused_XXXXXX, unreached_XXXXXX); sub_ ones are new.
# Lines elsewhere that use an old name (symbols.txt's 11 comments with enemy_behaviour_XXXXXX and object_setup_07F1A8,
# its "local unused_02A0CD 02A0D8 u target object", and the other param/local/scoped lines on unused_ and
# unreached_ functions) need the new name: the map below, one "# rename OLD NEW" a line.


# ======== the tables of code addresses the code loads into a register and jumps through ========

# ======== video/palette ========
# the palette requests (request_*): D, the request, kept while a free job is found (07BAEC/07BB12/07BB21/07BB71/07BB85/
# 07BBF6 "STD <$E8"; request_palette_clear 07BC78 "STA <$E8", its range bits only), then copied into the job (07BAFE,
# 07BB48, 07BB7D, 07BC6B "LDD <$E8"); its first byte the bits (which loads, ranges or layers: 07BB9F "LDA <$E8; BITA
# #$10"), its second the argument (the set, the frames: 07BB90 "LDA <$E9; STA #$04,U"); the window's bank kept while
# bank 2D or 2E is in (07BAF7 "LDA <$0E; STA <$EA", 07BB06 "LDB <$EA; STB <$0E")

# ======== common fields ========
# what kind of enemy it is to the engine: bit 7 (FF) not counted among the stage's enemies (07CB84 "LDA #$42,X; BMI;
# INC $1876") nor sharing out a player as its target (07D0E8 "LDA #$42,X; BMI" before "DEC #$45,U" on its target;
# enemy_release_target's first test); not 0, it has the goons' shared animations, the climbs' jumps 84 and 85 (07D6C9
# "LDA #$42,X; BEQ; LDA #$84; STA #$05,X"; 07D702, 07D7B1) and the walks by direction (07D7D1 "LDA #$42,X; LBNE $D2A2");
# the setups give it: 1 the goons (goon_base_set_up, hat_goon_set_up...), 2 the fat goons, FF the bosses and the props
# (bear_start, dreamland_boss_setup, fireman_goon_setup, marge_cloud_start), 0 when one comes in (bear_wait_entrance,
# fireman_goon_walk_out)
field object 42 enemy_class s8
# not 0 while the object has not come in yet (hidden, or waiting for the scroll or its cue): the enemies' list counts
# those at 0 (07CB8D "LDA #$57,X; BNE; INC $1883"), and while any is in the HURRY UP's frames stay at 0 (040CE9 "LDA
# $1883; BEQ; CLRD; STD <$93"); set at a setup (goon_run_in_set_up FF, ghost_on_rope_setup 1, gorilla_entrance_setup
# 80, football_player_start 14) and cleared as it comes in (goon_run_in_go, hat_goon_jump_in_show, wrestler_put_in,
# stage_7_boss_start_entrance, krusty_balloon_appear)
field object 57 entrance_pending u8
# the floor map's cell under it (check_floor 07CE10 "STA #$46,X"; a jump's floor ahead in x: goon_jump_in_leap,
# fat_goon_jump_in_jump C "OBJECT(object)->unk_46 = a" after vector_floor_ahead_x)
field object 46 floor_cell u8
# the cell where it is going (check_floor 07CE3E "STA #$47,X; CMPA <$F0", 07CE82 "LDB #$47,X" when it stands); the cell
# under it at its setup (start_object_from_setup 07D161 "STA #$47,X") or where it lands (goon_reach_floor_level,
# fat_goon_reach_ground C "OBJECT(object)->unk_47 = a")

# the level of the step an enemy met ahead, the cell's low 4 bits (check_floor_ahead 07CEAE "LDA <$F2; ANDA #$0F; STA

# ======== objects/object_lists.c ========
# 07CB6C-07CB82 "LDU #$F387; LDD #$01,X; PUSHS B,CC; LDB A,U; SETLN <$0E; PULLS CC,B; LDU #$F2EC; ASLA; JSR [A,U]":
# A is the object's type (field 01), B its state (field 02), U the enemies' handler table each handler is entered with
# 07CB6F "LDD #$01,X": window_bank = enemy_banks[(int8_t)a]
local run_enemies 07CB6F a object_type
# 07CB81 "ASLA": the handler's offset in the table, switch ((int8_t)a)
local run_enemies 07CB81 a handler_offset
# 07CB72/07CB7C "PUSHS B,CC ... PULLS CC,B": B, the object's state (field 02), handed to the handler (d = stack)
local run_enemies 07CB82 d state
# 07CB7E "LDU #$F2EC": the enemies' handler table, what every enemy handler finds in U (football_player, bear,
# stage_8_boss_run take it)
local run_enemies 07CB7E u enemy_handlers
# 07CBB0 "LDD #$01,X" (type, state), 07CBB5 "LDB A,U" (object_list_1_banks)
local run_list_1_objects 07CBB0 a object_type
# 07CBC2 "ASLA": the handler's offset in the F40D table
local run_list_1_objects 07CBC2 a handler_offset
# 07CBB3/07CBBD "PUSHS B,CC ... PULLS CC,B": the object's state handed to the handler
local run_list_1_objects 07CBC3 d state
# 07CBBF "LDU #$F40D; ASLA; JSR [A,U]": list 1's handler table, what each of its handlers finds in U
local run_list_1_objects 07CBBF u list_1_handlers
# 07CBE3 "LDD #$01,X", 07CBE8 "LDB A,U" (child_object_banks)
local run_child_objects 07CBE3 a object_type
# 07CBF5 "ASLA" before 07CBF6 "JSR [A,U]"
local run_child_objects 07CBF5 a handler_offset
# 07CBE6/07CBF0 "PUSHS B,CC ... PULLS CC,B": the object's state handed to the handler
local run_child_objects 07CBF6 d state
# 07CBF2 "LDU #$F4F4; ASLA; JSR [A,U]": the child objects' handler table, what each child's handler finds in U
local run_child_objects 07CBF2 u child_handlers
# 07CC12 "LDD #$01,X", 07CC17 "LDB A,U" (stage_event_banks)
local run_stage_event 07CC12 a object_type
# 07CC24 "ASLA" before 07CC25 "JSR [A,U]"
local run_stage_event 07CC24 a handler_offset
# 07CC15/07CC1F "PUSHS B,CC ... PULLS CC,B": the event object's state handed to its handler
local run_stage_event 07CC25 d state
# 07CC45 "LDA #$45,U; CMPA ,S": the player's count of enemies after it (the fewest kept on the stack)
local find_least_attacked_player 07CC45 a attackers
# 07CC38 "LDD #$7F04" (B = 4 players), 07CC56 "DBJNZ $CC40": the players left to look at
local find_least_attacked_player 07CC38,07CC56 b players_left
# 07CC69 "LDB $1876": the enemies counted last frame, the column of attackers_per_player (07CC85 "LDA B,U")
local share_out_attackers 07CC69 b enemies
# 07CC6D "LDA $1874": the players in the game (07CC71 "BEQ": none)
local share_out_attackers 07CC6D a players
# 07CC73 "DECA; BNE": the players besides one (07CC7E "DECA; ASLA x4": the row of 16 for 2 players and more)
local share_out_attackers 07CC73 a other_players
# done: objects/object_lists.c

# ======== parameters and locals: enemies, bosses, players ========
# Names for the
# variables still named after a register. Every line with its evidence above it.
#
# Conventions of this part:
#   box           a hit box record (LDY #$xxxx; LBSR set_hit_box), struct hit_box where the variable is the
#                 function's own (not the register a caller hands over)
#   child_record  a child object's record handed to spawn_child (LDY #$xxxx), struct child_object likewise
#   direction     what direction_to hands back in D; angle its high byte (A), the direction in 256ths of a turn
#   floor_cell    what floor_ahead / floor_ahead_x / floor_ahead_y hand back in D; floor_value its A (the cell's
#                 value: negative, no floor)
#   step_handlers the table of code addresses a dispatcher loads in U (LDU #$xxxx; JMP [B,U]) and leaves there for
#                 the steps it runs
#   step          the step a dispatcher's caller hands in B (the object's action_step, field 29, or its state)
#   step_offset   that step doubled (ASLB), the offset in the dispatcher's table

# ======== temporaries, typed pointers and the last register names ========
#. Evidence: build/listing/simpsons.s as PLACE "INSTRUCTION", the C of

# ======== new structures (the records the work list reached through untyped pointers) ========
# NOTE for the merge: palette_job lives at 3C00-3DFF and sprite_entry in the sprite RAM (2000-2FFF with 1FC2's bit 1):
# outside the work RAM, so ram() reaches them through the board's one shadow copy (simpsons_shadow_at). A statement
# that writes one of their fields with a value it reads from the bus in the same statement (mem_read8/io_read8 of a
# place the C does not name), or that touches two of them, depends on C's order of evaluation: see the report.

# A palette job: 8 bytes, 64 of them from 3C00 (find_free_palette_job 07BF39 "LDU #$3C00", 07BF3C "LDA #$40; STA
# <$7F", 07BF41 "LDA ,U; BEQ" a free one, 07BF45 "LEAU #$08,U"; run_palette_jobs 07BC8B-07BCA7 the same walk). Byte 0
# is the kind of job (0 free), the rest the kind's own (a family view each, by the request routines that fill them
# and the job routines that run them)
struct palette_job 08
# the kind of job (0 free): run_palette_jobs 07BC93 "LDA ,U; BEQ", 07BC99 "LDX #$BCAA; ASLA; JSR [A,X]" (1 the sets'
# loads, 2 an effect, 3 the background colour, 4 a darkening, 5 a brightening, 6 a white flash, 7 a clearing); the
# requests set it (07BAFA "LDA #$01; STA ,U", 07BB2F "LDA #$02", 07BB79 "LDA #$03", 07BB96 "LDA <$7E; STA ,U" 4 or 5,
# 07BC67 "LDA #$06", 07BC86 "LDA #$07") and the jobs that end clear it (07BCC6 "CLR ,U", 07BDFD, 07BEF6, 07BDB0)
field palette_job 00 kind u8
# kind 1, a palette set's loads (request_palette_sets 07BAFE "LDD <$E8; STD #$01,U": the request's A and B):
# palette_job_load_sets 07BCC8 "LDA #$01,U; STA <$F0" the loads wanted, a bit each of the set's 4 (07BCE6 "ANDA
# #$01", 07BCF8 "LSR <$F0"), 07BCD1 "LDB #$02,U; BPL" the set (bit 7: palette_sets_high, 07BCD6 "LDX #$EAEB; ANDB #$7F")
scoped palette_job sets 01 loads u8
scoped palette_job sets 02 set u8
# kind 2, a palette effect (request_palette_effect 07BB1F-07BB5F; palette_job_effect 07BD01): byte 1 the direction
# it runs its steps in (07BD36 "LDA #$01,U; ASLA; JSR [A,Y]" by palette_effect_directions: 0 forward, 1 backward;
# 07BB3F "CLR #$01,U", 07BDB4 "LDA #$01; STA #$01,U" turning back, 07BD8C "CLR #$01,U" at the start again)
scoped palette_job effect 01 direction u8
# the step it is at, in bank 2E (07BB5F "STX #$02,U" after the effect's header, 07BD28 "LDX #$02,U", 07BD67 / 07BD92 /
# 07BDBC / 07BDD6 "STX #$02,U")
scoped palette_job effect 02 step u16
# the frames waited since the last step (07BD0D "LDA #$04,U; CMPA #$05,U; BNE", 07BD4D "INC #$04,U", 07BD25 "CLR
# #$04,U"), the effect's frames between steps (07BB57 "LDA ,X+; STA #$04,U; STA #$05,U")
scoped palette_job effect 04 frames_waited u8
scoped palette_job effect 05 delay u8
# the colours a step sets, less one (07BB52 "LDA ,X+; STA #$06,U"; 07BD51 "LDA #$06,U; STA <$F0", counted to 0)
scoped palette_job effect 06 extra_colours u8
# the times the effect's repeat command has gone back (palette_effect_repeat 07BDC8 "CMPA #$07,U; BEQ", 07BDCD "INC
# #$07,U", 07BDDB "CLR #$07,U"; 07BB42 "CLR #$07,U" at the start)
scoped palette_job effect 07 repeats u8
# kind 3, the background colour (request_background_colour 07BB7D "LDD <$E8; STD #$01,U"; palette_job_background_colour
# 07BDF6 "LDD #$01,U; STD $0C00")
scoped palette_job background 01 colour u16
# kinds 4 and 5, a fade (request_palette_fade 07BB85; palette_job_fade 07BE21): the palette ranges it works on, a bit
# a step (07BBEC "LDD <$EA; STD #$01,U; STD #$05,U"; 07BE2B "LDD #$01,U; STD #$05,U" each 16 steps)
scoped palette_job fade 01 ranges u16
# the frames it lasts, one step a frame (07BB8D "CLR #$03,U", 07BB90 "LDA <$E9; STA #$04,U" the request's B;
# palette_job_darken 07BE1C "LDD #$03,U; BEQ" done, 07BE21 "DECW #$03,U")
scoped palette_job fade 03 frames_left u16
# the ranges still to come, shifted one bit a step (07BE71 "LSRW #$05,U"), whose bit 0 says the step's range fades
# (07BE34 "LDA #$06,U; ANDA #$01")
scoped palette_job fade 05 ranges_left u16
# the step, 0-15: the range of fade_ranges it fades (07BE50 "LDA #$07,U; ASLA; ASLA; LEAX A,X", 07BE74 "INC #$07,U",
# 07BE24 "CMPA #$10" then 07BE31 "CLR #$07,U")
scoped palette_job fade 07 range u8
# kind 6, a white flash (request_white_flash 07BC6B "LDD <$E8; STD #$01,U": the request's A, the layers that flash,
# and B, its frames; palette_job_white_flash 07BE8B "DEC #$02,U; BEQ")
scoped palette_job flash 01 flash_layers u8
scoped palette_job flash 02 frames_left u8
# the K053251's registers 9 and 10 while the flash shows, every other frame (07BC71 "LDD <$EA; STD #$03,U" from the
# layer bits; 07BEA5 "LDA #$03,U; STA $1FB9", 07BEAC "LDA #$04,U; STA $1FBA")
scoped palette_job flash 03 k053251_9 u8
scoped palette_job flash 04 k053251_10 u8
# kind 7, a clearing: the palette_clears it clears, a bit each (request_palette_clear 07BC80 "LDA <$E8; STA #$01,U";
# palette_job_clear 07BEFB "LDA #$01,U; STA <$F1", 07BF04 "ANDA #$01", 07BF1B "LSR <$F1")
scoped palette_job clearing 01 ranges u8

# A sprite of the K053247, 16 bytes (MAME's k053246_k053247_k055673.cpp, "Sprite Format"), in the sprite RAM at 2000
# (1FC2's bit 1): each object has 8 of them from its field sprites (2000 + 80 x its number: 07955F "LDU #$2000",
# 079575 "LEAU #$0080,U"); the sprite engine writes them (write_object_sprites 079C02, write_shadow_sprite 079DFE), the
# VBLANK's DMA copies those with bit 7 of byte 0 and a depth to the K053247
struct sprite_entry 10
# bit 7 shown, bit 6 the zoom kept for both axes, bit 5 flipped vertically, bit 4 horizontally, bits 0-3 the size:
# 079C2C "LDA <$F4; EORA <$F5; ORA ,U+; STA #$00,Y" (frame_attributes C0, 10 facing left, the sprite list's size),
# 079CD9 "LDA #$00,Y; ANDA #$BF" (a zoomed object: each axis its own zoom); 07989B "STD ,U" / 079CB2 "STD ,Y" clear it,
# 0798B7 / 079CAD "TST ,U" / "LDB ,Y; BEQ" the last one used
field sprite_entry 00 flags u8
# the depth the K053247 sorts by: sort_objects_by_depth's order, 1 up from the objects lowest on the screen, 0 for an
# object without bit 7 of its flags (079A9F "LDA <$F1; LDB #$00,X; BMI; CLRA", 079AA8 "STA #$01,U", 079AAB "INC <$F1")
field sprite_entry 01 depth u8
# the sprite's code (079C0B / 079C15 "STD #$02,Y" from the sprite list, bit 15 off: flipped)
field sprite_entry 02 code u16
# y and x on the screen (079C59 "STD #$04,Y": the object's y + z + the sprite's offset; 079C4D "STD #$06,Y": x + the
# offset; zoomed 079DCC / 079D4E)
field sprite_entry 04 y u16
field sprite_entry 06 x u16
# the vertical and horizontal zooms' low bytes (40 normal: 079C5C "LDA #$40; STA #$09,Y"; a zoomed object's 079D6A
# "STB #$09,Y" field 0B, 079CEA "STB #$0B,Y" field 0A, at least 10)
field sprite_entry 09 zoom_y u8
field sprite_entry 0B zoom_x u8
# the priority against the layers (the high byte: object_sprite_priority, 079C18 "LDA <$FB"; the shadow sprite's with
# bit 7, 079E22 "LDA <$FB; ORA #$80") and the colour (079C20 "LDB ,U+" from the sprite list, or the object's
# attributes' low bits 079C27 "ANDB #$0F"): 079C29 "STD #$0C,Y"
field sprite_entry 0C priority u8
field sprite_entry 0D colour u8
# the last of an object's 8 holds the object whose sprites it goes on in when a frame needs more (draw_object 079BE7
# "LDX #$7E,Y; BNE", 079BEC "LBSR $9CBD" borrow_object_for_sprites, 079BFD "STX #$7E,Y"; write_object_sprites 079C6E
# "LDD #$-02,Y" then 079C75 "LDY #$59,Y" its sprites; 079C9A "LDU #$-02,Y; BEQ", 079CA0 "STD #$-02,Y", 079CA5 "CLR ,Y"
# the object freed)
field sprite_entry 0E borrowed_object u16 object

# A word of the main loop's job queue (job_queue, 4944-497F round): the job's kind in the high byte and its argument
# in the low one, FFFF none (boot 0789CB "LDX $4942; LDD ,X; BMI", 0789D3 "LDU #$FFFF; STU ,X++", 0789E4 "LDX #$E3FB;
# ASLA; JSR [A,X]"; queue_job 0797C3 "STD ,X++")
struct queued_job 02
field queued_job 00 job u16
field queued_job 00 kind u8


# ---- bonus/balloon.c (the bonus stages' temporaries, untyped pointers and register names) ----
# Evidence: build/listing/simpsons.s as PLACE "INSTRUCTION", the C of the Cbonus/balloon.c.
# The scenes' dispatchers read their state in the K052109's RAM (scene_state 18E0, scene_substate 18E1, bonus 2's
# 1840), double it and jump through a table they load in X (or U): the state's number, its offset in the table and
# the table are named so; the "INC $18E0" / "INC $18E1" / "CLR $18E1" that end a state read the number first (t1).

# bonus_1_contest: 0200FD "LDX #$7B86", 020100 "LDA $18E0", 020104 "ASLA", 020105 "JMP [A,X]"
local bonus_1_contest 0200FD x state_table
local bonus_1_contest 020100 t1 state_number
local bonus_1_contest 020104 a state_offset
# bonus_2_contest: 020ACF "LDA $1840" (bonus 2's state, at least 3: 020AD3 "CMPA #$03; BGE", 020AD7 "LDA #$03; STA
# $1840"), 020ADD "ASLA", 020AE1 "JMP [A,X]"
local bonus_2_contest 020ACF t1 read_state
local bonus_2_contest 020ACF,020AD7 a state_number
# wrestler_update: 0212FB "LDU #$7E2F" the wrestler's states, 0212FE "LDA #$02,X; ASLA", 021302 "JSR [A,U]"
local wrestler_update 0212FB u state_table

# A player's controls, 4 bytes from 4840 + 4 x player (player_controls): update_controls keeps them from the port at
# U (07924D "LDA ,X; STA #$01,X", 079252 "LDA ,U; COMA; STA ,X", 079257 "LDA #$01,X; ANDA ,X; STA #$03,X", 07925F "LDA
# #$01,X; COMA; ANDA ,X; STA #$02,X"), for the IRQ's 4 ports (079092 "LDU #$1F90; LDX #$4840; LBSR $9248" ...
# 0790B0 "LDX #$484C") and the attract's demo inputs (07A1B4-07A1DB "LDX #$4840" ... "LBSR $924D"); bonus_player's
# controls_pressed and player_variable_records' held point into them
struct player_input 04
field player_input 00 now u8
field player_input 01 last u8
field player_input 02 pressed u8
field player_input 03 held u8

# the settings the test mode keeps after the coin setting (59F1), which eeprom_load_settings copies from the EEPROM's
# 68-7D to 59F0-59FD (05EA81 "LDU #$59F0; LDA #$68", 05EA89 "STB ,U+") and apply_settings reads by X = 59F1: the
# OPTIONS page's lines (assets/data/texts.txt: "3 DIFFICULTY", "4 SOUND IN ATTRACT MODE", "5 VIDEO SCREEN FLIP", "6
# SOUND OUTPUT"); 078A56 "LDA #$03,X; STA <$14" (difficulty_setting)
59F4  var  difficulty_option  u8
# 078A4F "LDA #$04,X; INCA; STA <$5A": the lives a credit gives, less one
59F5  var  lives_option  u8
# 078A5C "LDA #$05,X; STA <$13" (attract_sound)
59F6  var  attract_sound_option  u8
# 078A62 "LDA #$06,X; BNE" the screen flipped (1E80, the K053246's 1FA5 bits 0-1, flip_screen)
59F7  var  screen_flip_option  u8
# 078ACD "LDB #$08,X; BEQ", 078AD2 "ORA #$04": board_output's bit 2 (1FC0: MAME's simpsons.cpp, "bit 2 selects mono or
# stereo sound")
59F9  var  sound_output_option  u8
# 078AD7 "LDA #$09,X; STA <$3A" (first_credit_extra_coins: the coins more a slot's first credit takes)
59FA  var  first_credit_coins_option  u8

# ======== temporaries, typed pointers and locals: objects k-z ========
# objects_b (objects/k* to z*): temporaries, untyped pointers and the last register names
# Proposals in symbols.txt syntax; each with its evidence above it. Conventions used throughout:
#   an object's x is on the screen (x + camera_x is the stage's x: 02D8E1 "ADDD <$AC"), so a load of x compared with
#   a constant is `screen_x`; one compared with another object's is `own_x`, the other's `target_x`, `device_x`...;
#   `old_x` / `new_x` (`old_y` / `new_y`) are a field read and written back moved (LDD #$0C,X; ADDD #n; STD #$0C,X),
#   `new_z_speed` the z speed with gravity taken off (LDD #$19,X; SUBD #n; STD #$19,X);
#   an ABSD is a difference (`x_difference`), its copy (`signed_x_difference`) and its size (`x_distance`).
#   a CLR of the tile chip's spare RAM (1840-18FF) reads before it clears: those reads are `old_...`.

# One of an enemy behaviour's 4 attack ranges (enemy_behaviour.ranges, 12 bytes each from its byte 28), which
# enemy_find_attack_range and enemy_think read: 07D3E9 "LDB #$2F,X; CMPB ,U; BHI" (the most distance in depth),
# 07D3F0 "LDB #$2D,X; CMPB #$01,U; BCS; CMPB #$02,U; BLS" (the least and the most across), 07D406 "LDA #$03,U" (the
# chance to attack), enemy_think's 07D5D9 "LEAU #$07,U; ... SUBA B,U" (the 4 actions' chances, B 4 to 1) and 07D5E5
# "LEAU #$-04,U; LDA B,U; STA #$28,X" (the 4 actions)
struct attack_range 0C rom
field attack_range 00 most_dy u8
field attack_range 01 least_dx u8
field attack_range 02 most_dx u8
field attack_range 03 chance u8
field attack_range 04 actions u8[4]
field attack_range 08 action_chances u8[4]
# 07D5C3 "LEAU #$28,U; LBSR $D3D7": the first range, 07D3FD "LEAU #$0C,U" the next
param enemy_find_attack_range u range attack_range
local enemy_find_attack_range 07D3FD u range attack_range
# 07D3D7 "LDD #$2C,X; CMPD #$0100" and 07D3DF "LDD #$2E,X; CMPD #$0100" (too far: A, the distance's high byte, is
# handed back with no carry); 07D3E7 "LDA #$04", 07D400 "DECA; BNE": the ranges left to look at
local enemy_find_attack_range 07D3D7,07D3DF a distance_high
local enemy_find_attack_range 07D3E7,07D400 a ranges_left
local enemy_find_attack_range 07D400 t1 ranges_before
# 07D3E9 "LDB #$2F,X" (the depth distance's low byte), 07D3F0 "LDB #$2D,X" (the x distance's), 07D3F3 "CMPB #$01,U",
# 07D3F8 "CMPB #$02,U", 07D406 "LDA #$03,U"
local enemy_find_attack_range 07D3E9 t3 dy_low
local enemy_find_attack_range 07D3F0 t3 dx_low
local enemy_find_attack_range 07D3F3 t3 range_least_dx
local enemy_find_attack_range 07D3F8 t3 range_most_dx
local enemy_find_attack_range 07D406 t3 range_chance
# done: enemies/enemy_targets.c

# ---- players/players.c ----
# A player's variables, 8 bytes from 49D0 + 8 x player (the player records point into them; 1848 holds the running
# player's: 03801B "LDX #$49D0; STX $1848" ... player_run's X): its lives (00, a word: 038FD9 "LDD [$1848]; CMPD #$0001"), the
# life it keeps (02: 03813B "LDB #$02,X; STB #$1B,U"), where its object is (03: 0380B5 "TST #$03,X", 038141 "LDB
# #$01; STB #$03,X", 039305 "LDX $1848", 039309 "LDA #$02", 03930B "STA #$03,X", 039054 "LDX $1848", 039058 "CLR #$03,X"), its score (04, BCD: 49D4 + 8n), its grab
# hints (06: 0395B9 "LDA #$06,Y; CMPA #$05"), its state (07: 07B985 "LDY #$49D0; LDB #$07,Y; CMPB #$03");
# symbols.txt names their bytes for each player (marge_entry_status, homer_lives, marge_score, marge_grab_hints,
# marge_state...)
struct player_values 08
field player_values 00 lives u16
field player_values 02 kept_life u8
field player_values 03 entry_status u8
field player_values 04 score u16
field player_values 06 grab_hints u8
field player_values 07 state u8
# A coin slot's record, 8 bytes from 4817 + 8 x slot (the note at slot_credits: add_coin 0791F7-079244 by U), which
# update_players hands each player's state routine in U (07B70D "LDU #$4817", 07B724 "LEAU #$08,U"): its credits
# when each slot has its own (00: 07B744 / 07B7F7 / 07B85B "LDD #$00,U", 07B784 "LDY #$00,U", 07B797 "STD #$00,U"),
# the coins towards a credit (02: 0791F7 "INC #$02,U"), the coin counter's pulses (03) and their time (04), the
# coins a credit takes (05) and the credits they give (06), whether it gave a credit already (07: 079244 "STA
# #$07,U", 07B89A "CLR #$07,U")
struct coin_slot 08
field coin_slot 00 own_credits u16
field coin_slot 02 coins u8
field coin_slot 03 counter_pulses u8
field coin_slot 04 counter_time u8
field coin_slot 05 coins_per_credit u8
field coin_slot 06 credits_per_coins u8
field coin_slot 07 credit_given u8
local update_players 07B70D,07B724 u slot coin_slot
param player_out u slot coin_slot
param player_join u slot coin_slot
param player_playing u slot coin_slot
param player_continue_countdown u slot coin_slot
param player_game_over u slot coin_slot
# A player's counters, 7 bytes from 4A00 + 7 x player (the player records' countdown, field 07, and the gauge
# records' counters, field 02): the continue's countdown, BCD seconds (00: 07B82B "LDA #$20; STA [#$07,X]", 07B87E
# "LDA #$99; ADDA ,Y; DAA; STA ,Y") and its frames (01: 07B871 "INC #$01,Y; LDA #$01,Y; CMPA #$3C"), or game over's
# frames (00: 07B89D "INC [#$07,X]; LDA [#$07,X]; CMPA #$C0"); the health gauge's shown step (02: 040A0D "CMPB
# #$02,U", 040A34 "STA #$02,U") and the frames until its next step (03: 040A20 "TST #$03,U", 040A39 "STB #$03,U",
# 0408EE "LDA #$03,Y; DECA; STA #$03,Y"). symbols.txt calls bytes 02-06 unused (unused_marge_word_1 at 4A02...):
# the gauge uses 02 and 03 through this pointer
struct player_counters 07

# ======== temporaries, typed pointers and locals: scenes, stages, attract ========
# ======== the temporaries, untyped pointers and register names of src/attract,
# src/scenes and src/stages ========
# Evidence by place in build/listing/simpsons.s. Conventions of this part:
# - a countdown decremented and tested ("DEC <$0B; BNE": t = the count before the decrement, "if (t == 1u)" its last
#   frame) is wait_left (the scenes' own counters at 18E2/18E3... are ..._wait); a scroll's low byte and fraction read
#   with "LDD <$BF" and then added to or subtracted from is layer_a_x_low (the read), old_layer_a_x_low (the operand
#   the ADDD/SUBD takes) and new_layer_a_x_low (the result), and likewise for the other layers and the camera
# - "INC $18E0" (scene_state) and the like: the read the INC makes first is old_scene_state; a CLR of memory reads it
#   first too, which nothing uses: discarded_read
# - a cursor's value before a post-increment read (",X+", ",U++": the read's t1) is named for what it reads: ..._at.

# ======== the attract's demo playback (work RAM) ========
# Each player's demo playback, 5810 + 10 x player: 07A0D2 "LDY #$5810", 07A117/07A19A "LEAY #$10,Y" (4 of them,
# 07A123/07A1A6 "CMPA #$04"); read and written by demo_start and demo_play:
# 07A0F2 "LDU ,X++; STU ,Y" (the player's inputs in bank 2C), 07A17A "LDU ,Y; LDA ,U", 07A186 "LEAU #$02,U", 07A198
# "STU ,Y" (the next input step); 07A0F6 "LDA #$01,U; STA #$02,Y", 07A181 "DEC #$02,Y", 07A192 "LDA #$01,U; STA
# #$02,Y" (the frames left of the step); 07A0FC "LDA ,U; STA #$03,Y", 07A17C "LDA ,U; STA #$03,Y" (its controls, which
# 07A1AA "COM $5813; LDU #$5813; LBSR $924D" hands update_controls as the player's port: marge_demo_controls...);
# 07A18E "COMA; STA #$04,Y" (the controls inverted; nothing reads them back)
struct demo_playback 10
field demo_playback 00 input u16 demo_input
field demo_playback 02 frames u8
field demo_playback 03 controls u8
field demo_playback 04 controls_inverted u8

local demo_play 07A181 t3 step_frames_left

# ======== the board's memory the program uses as variables, by name ========
# ======== the board's addresses the 053248's C reads and writes as numbers, by name ========
# io lines (ADDRESS io NAME TYPE): the C then reads io_read8(NAME), and a constant the code puts in X, Y or U that equals
# the address is printed by the name too (stage_7_scene_lift's "clear_from = scene_state"), so each name below was also
# checked against the constants of its value in src/ (noted where they are not that thing).
#
# The K052109 only decodes 180C-1833 (layer A's y scroll), 1A00-1BFF (layer A's x scroll), 1C00, 1C80, 1D00, 1D80,
# 1E00, 1E80, 1F00 and the same of layer B at 380C/3A00 (MAME konami/k052109.cpp, k052109_device::write); the rest of
# 1800-1FFF and 3800-3FFF is RAM the program keeps variables in. Boot clears 1840-19FF and 3840-39FF (0787A9 "LDX #$1840;
# ... LDU #$01BF; BMOVE", 0787B9 "LDX #$3840"), reset_sprites_and_objects 18E0-18FF, 1860-18DF and 1840-185F (079652,
# 07965D, 079668). One name per address: where scenes reuse a byte for their own ends, the name is that of most uses
# and the comment says what else keeps it there.

# ============================================================================================ 1840-185F: the stage's
# ---- the bonuses' bytes (1840-1846; outside the bonuses the step's start copies the scene's camera lines there: 03ED31
# "LDY #$7EDC; LEAY A,Y; LDX #$1840; LDU #$0008; BMOVE Y,X,U", story_scene_settings, and player_request_scroll reads
# them as four words: 03993B "CMPX $1840", 03997C "CMPX $1842", 039983 "LDX $1844", 039942 "LDX $1846") ----
# bonus 2's state: 020A32 "LDA $1840; ASLA; LDX #$7D18; JMP [A,X]" (bonus_2_contest by it), 020A42/020A8B "INC $1840"
# (bonus_2_start_music, bonus_2_intro_set_up), 020B13 "LDY #$0464; STY $1840" (state 4 and 64 frames), 020BAF "STA
# $1840" (5), 020BDD/020BFC "STD $1840" (628, 70A), 020CD1/020DEE/020E66 read it; 17 of its 20 uses. Also the first
# camera line (player_request_scroll's word), and the start of the cleared block (boot.c, reset.c, scene_load_story_
# settings's "copy_to", ram_rom_check's "start": those constants read bonus_2_state too)
1840  io  bonus_2_state  u8
# bonus 2's frames: 020B9E "DEC $1841" (bonus_2_countdown: at 1 the music 8A00 and state 5), 020BE3 "TST $1841",
# 020BE9 "DEC $1841" (bonus_2_results), 020C17 "DEC $1841" (bonus_2_end); set with the state by 020B16 "STY $1840"
1841  io  bonus_2_timer  u8
# the bonuses' results' state: 020F39 "LDA $1842; ASLA; LDX #$7D8D; JMP [A,X]" (bonus_results by it,
# bonus_results_states), 020F45 "STA $1842" (1), 020FC6/020FD5/02109F/021180 "STD $1842" (state and frames),
# 0211E6 "TST $1842" (bonus_show_player_portraits); 7 of its 8 uses (the eighth: the second camera line). u16: the state
# is a byte, but 5 of the 8 uses are words (state and frames written together, and the camera line)
1842  io  bonus_results_state  u16
# the results' frames: 020F87 "DEC $1843; BNE; INC $1843" (bonus_results_second, _third, _fourth), 020FBD/020FCC/021017
# "DEC $1843", 02101F "STA $1843" (4: bonus_results_count_points)
1843  io  bonus_results_timer  u8
# the result last placed: 020F4B "STA $1844" (FF at the start), 0210B8 "CMPB $1844" (each round takes the best result
# below it), 0210D9 "STB $1844", 0210F5 "CMPA $1844" (the boxes of that result placed); 4 of 5 uses (the fifth: the
# third camera line)
1844  io  results_last_result  u8
# the result boxes placed so far: 020F7B "CLR $1845", 02115E "INC $1845" (each box placed), 02116F "LDA $1845" (all four
# placed: the results go on to state 5)
1845  io  results_boxes_placed  u8
# the place being given (1st, 2nd...): 020F77 "STA $1846" (1), 021131 "LDA $1846" (into the box: its place), 021184
# "INC $1846" (after each result); 4 of 5 uses (the fifth: the fourth camera line)
1846  io  results_place  u8
# ---- the players' run ----
# the running player's values (player_values, 49D0 + 8 x player): 03801E/038038/038052/03806C "STX $1848" (player_run_all,
# 49D0 49D8 49E0 49E8 before each player_run), 038FD9 "LDD [$1848]; CMPD #$0001" (its last life), 03905E "DECW
# [$1848]" (a life less), 039305/0395B5/039865 "LDX $1848"/"LDY $1848" (player_take_touches, player_get_grabbed,
# player_keep_life)
1848  io  running_player_values  u16
# a count or phase the objects of one set share: the football player's line pieces (03C8A6 "LDA $184A", 03C8AF "INC
# $184A": up to 8, each piece by it; 03C393/03C733 "CLR $184A"; football_player_wait_cue waits for it), the bear's
# phase for its parts (03C91D "CLR", 03C998 "STA" 1, 03CA11 "STB" 2: the parts fly; 03CE65 "LDA $184A"), kind 10's
# droppers down (02C374 "INC $184A": the first rewrites the floor)
184A  io  object_group_count  u8
# the players stop for a scene: 07B666 "LDA #$01; STA $184B" (stage_over), 07A9B7 (stage_3_forest_cleared), 07B32C
# (stage_8_first_part_exit), 02655B (krusty_balloon_beaten_wait), 03E497 (story_actor_wait_for_players), 03E511 (the
# height story_actor_wait_for_height waits for); the players' code tests it, 03807A/0380BB/038B1A/038E96/039170 "TST
# $184B" (no controls, a team-up broken up, stand still); cleared by 03E736 (story_actor_remove) and 03ED43 (each step's
# start)
184B  io  players_stop_request  u8
# the players standing or absent this frame: 038003 "CLR $184C" (player_run_all), 0380B0 "INC $184C" (a player not in
# the game, or all idle already), 038471 "INC $184C" (player_stand); 038080 "LDA $184C; CMPA #$04" (all four)
184C  io  players_idle_count  u8
# the players done working a heavy object (three attacks each): 038007 "CLR $184D", 03914B "INC $184D"

3842  io  name_entry_records  u8

385E  io  name_entry_time  u16

3860  io  name_entry_ranking  u8
